## Context / Problem

The `criteria eval` CLI admits only plan-review ids: its preflight rejects anything not in `plan_review.registry.by_id(repo_root)` (`src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:143-155`), so an activated project **code-review** criterion is refused as "unknown" before the gate-aware eval resolver is ever reached. Fifth of five seams (root cause on superseded bug 8a4b).

## Approach

Extend the preflight to admit code-review ids and to resolve the target gate deterministically:

- Look the id up in BOTH the plan-review effective registry and the code-review effective registry (`code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)`, `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:179-184`).
- Admit iff present in **exactly one** gate; dispatch to the gate-aware calibrate path that child 4 `[rebar:8153-e9b5-5706-49c8]` adds to `calibrate_criterion`.
- If the id is active in **both** gates, reject as **ambiguous** with a message telling the author which gates claim it; if in neither, keep the existing "unknown" error.
- Update the subparser help text to include the concrete project code-review example `project.foo` alongside the plan-review example.

**Rejected alternative.** Adding a `criteria eval --gate` flag — heavier UX for a rare case; the "active in exactly one gate ⇒ resolve there" rule covers the common path and only genuine cross-gate ambiguity needs operator input.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py` — dual-registry admission, one-gate resolution, ambiguity rejection, help text.
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py` — append CLI cases to this shared test file, which was created by child 1 `[rebar:fc72-bf7e-7652-4228]`. This ticket depends on child 1 and child 4 `[rebar:8153-e9b5-5706-49c8]`; tests build a synthetic repo activating `project.foo` as a code-review criterion.

## Testing

- Happy path (CLI): `project.foo`, active in code-review only, is admitted and reaches the calibrate call with exit 0.
- Unknown edge: an id active in neither registry returns exit 1 and emits the existing "unknown" message.
- Ambiguity edge: `project.foo` active in both registries returns exit 1 and emits an "ambiguous" message naming `plan_review` and `code_review`.
- Help text: `criteria eval --help` contains the exact substring `project.foo` in the code-review example.

Tier: unit — invoke the command handler with a synthetic-repo `repo_root`, with calibration stubbed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A one-gate project code-review id is admitted and dispatched to the code-review calibrate path; verified by `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k cli`.
- [ ] An unknown id is rejected with exit 1 and the existing distinct "unknown" message; verified by the same `-k cli` selector.
- [ ] An id active in both gates is rejected with exit 1 and an "ambiguous" message naming `plan_review` and `code_review`; verified by the same `-k cli` selector.
- [ ] `criteria eval --help` contains the exact code-review example substring `project.foo`; verified by the same `-k cli` selector.
